text:
nina: Quick sync: onboarding quasar-8b into catalog. Need final weights path, tokenizer fix for newline/pad token, and perf plan.

ashok: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/weights.pt :eyes: Can someone validate md5? I also uploaded model_card.md.

ben: I started a tokenizer pass — tokenizer.json missing a pad token; generation pads with id 0 which breaks beam search. I can add pad token id 50256 and reserialize.

loren: Thanks @ben. Can you drop the patched tokenizer under s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/tokenizer-patch/tokenizer.json? I will point the catalog to that if small.

ben: Done. patch path: s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/tokenizer-patch/tokenizer_v2.json

nina: Perf plan: throughput sweep batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16]; seq lens [32,128,512]; 10 warmup + 5 measured runs. Measure p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec. Put logs in /bench/quasar8b/<run_ts>. Use run_bench.sh --kv-cache.

loren: Also run quantized compares (q8 vs q4) to show cost/latency tradeoffs.

tara: Heads up: dedicated infra in us-west2 is tight tonight — might need to run some on us-east1. @infra please advise.

devops-bot: deploy-bench job queued: job id 54231. Estimated runtime 45m on us-east1-gpu. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/54231

ashok: Config validation snippet:

```
model:
  name: quasar-8b
  weights: s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/weights.pt
  tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/tokenizer-patch/tokenizer_v2.json
serve:
  max_batch_size: 16
  kv_cache: true
  quantization: q8_0
```

loren: Running the config validator now. Suspected nit: vocab_size mismatch between tokenizer (50260) and model config (50257).

ben: I regenerated tokenizer to vocab_size 50257 but kept explicit pad at 50256. Pushed tokenizer_v3.json to s3://redwood-models/quasar8b/q8_v2/tokenizer-patch/tokenizer_v3.json

ashok: I'll re-run validator and attach results.

devops-bot: validator: schema ok; vocab mismatch warning resolved by tokenizer_v3. Passed.

nina: Great. Checklist: weights MD5 ✅, tokenizer ✅, validator ✅, perf logs uploaded ✅, PR for catalog with p50/p95 and recommended batch sizes ✅

ashok: :thumbsup: starting full perf sweep now, will upload logs when done.

tara: Reserved us-east1-g4 slot for 1h at 03:00 UTC. :rocket:

loren: Rollout spec ready. Canary 5% with fallback to ceres-6b and q4 fallback variant. PR incoming ~30m.

ben: Running final smoke — sample prompts + end-to-end tokenization/generation.

nina: Thanks team. I'll open catalog PR once perf numbers are pasted. Tag me when ready. :eyes:

loren: LGTM

ben: all green on smoke

nina: merging once PR CI passes, thanks!
